role: Value object types for statistical expectations and similarity clusters in the perception service
detail: Defines two frozen immutable types for Epic 4 similarity analysis: PropertyExpectation (Pydantic BaseModel) tracks statistical distribution of a property across instances of a schema type, including mean_vector centroid, variance, sample_count, confirmation_count, prediction_errors, confidence (0.0-1.0), provenance source, and is_active status; confidence updates per D-TS-10 formula min(1.0, current + (1.0 - current) * 0.1) on confirmation, and activation requires sample_count >= 3 across multiple sessions (D-TS-15). SimilarityCluster (frozen dataclass) represents a group of instance nodes identified by embedding proximity, tracking member_node_ids, centroid_node_id, mean_pairwise_similarity, mean_cross_similarity, contrast_ratio (pairwise / cross, or inf if no cross), label_raw_distribution (frequency map), and session_ids. Both types are immutable by design; updates create new instances rather than mutation. No DB/network side effects; pure data structures.
gotchas: SimilarityCluster uses frozen dataclass instead of Pydantic because it never crosses API boundaries and Pydantic overhead not justified; contrast_ratio can be float('inf') when mean_cross_similarity is 0; confidence ceiling at 1.0 per CANON standards; expectation is derived aggregate so provenance is enum value not full Provenance object
